svg.title: C for Creative Concepts and Campaign
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. The C from the original poster transforms into a lightbulb, then leads to creative concepts and campaign. Three graphic cards show concept, key visual, and campaign outputs. The source illustration has been traced as vector paths.
svg.metadata: 16:9 aspect ratio; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; derived from 03_C_creative.png; self-contained SVG.

g.text: A SINGLE IDEA. A CAMPAIGN THAT CONNECTS.
